profile.hero_description: Specializing in mobile application and web development with Flutter, Dart, Laravel, and React. Passionate about clean code, efficient problem-solving, application performance, and delivering reliable software through modern development practices.
profile.about_story:
I am a Software Developer specializing in mobile application and web development, with proficiency in Flutter, Dart, and modern web technologies. Experienced in designing, developing, and optimizing responsive, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions with a strong focus on clean code, efficient problem-solving, and delivering high application performance.

Currently pursuing my Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering at Northern University Bangladesh (2024 – Present). In addition to technical engineering, I serve as Senior Graphic Secretary at NUB Computer Club (NUBCC) leading visual design initiatives, and contributed as Junior Software Developer at Neurootix IT.

allProjects.title: Padma TV Web App & Digital Newsroom
allProjects.subtitle: 24/7 Live Broadcast & Multi-Upazila News Platform
allProjects.overview: A premier 24/7 digital broadcast and news publishing web platform engineered for Padma TV, featuring live television streaming, video journalism, granular regional coverage across all 7 upazilas of Manikganj district, and an executive administration dashboard.
allProjects.description:
Padma TV is a complete digital broadcast and regional journalism platform. It bridges high-definition live television streaming with deep local reporting. Viewers can watch 24/7 live streams, explore curated video documentaries, read breaking news updates, and filter regional reports by upazilas (Manikganj Sadar, Singair, Saturia, Shibaloy, Harirampur, Daulatpur, Ghior).

For editorial staff, Padma TV incorporates a full-featured digital newsroom CMS dashboard welcoming Md. Atik Hasan (Chief Administrator & Editor). This centralized portal enables instant publishing of articles, video broadcasts, breaking news tickers, media library management, and comment moderation.
allProjects.objective: Build a responsive, zero-latency digital media and broadcasting platform delivering real-time news to readers on any device while giving editorial teams centralized content governance.
features: 24/7 Low-latency Live TV video stream player integration
Dedicated regional hub covering all 7 upazilas of Manikganj district with interactive filters
Curated video journalism portal with video duration badges and play-on-demand
Live breaking news banner ticker and trending topic hashtags (#মানিকগঞ্জ_আপডেট)
Bilingual interface toggle (বাংলা / ENG) with instant theme switching (Dark / Light)
Executive digital newsroom dashboard with publishing metrics (10 published news, 4 video stories, reader views)
Centralized CMS drawer for articles, media library, upazilas, categories, and security settings
Reader bookmarks and offline reading list (সংরক্ষিত খবর)

images.caption: Public Live News Feed with Live TV button, search bar, language toggle, and Shaheed Rafiq Library featured report
Video Newsroom & Live Stream hub with duration badges (04:25) and Harirampur documentary story
Regional Upazila Directory covering Manikganj 7 Upazilas with interactive filter pills and Paturia ferry service report
Central Digital Newsroom Admin Dashboard welcoming Md. Atik Hasan (Chief Administrator & Editor) with metrics cards
Editorial Management Navigation Drawer showcasing CMS settings, media library, upazilas, and security controls

allProjects.title: Tour Partner
allProjects.subtitle: Flagship Travel Companion Mobile App
allProjects.overview: A complete travel companion mobile app engineered for exploring destinations, planning multi-day itineraries, tracking shared expenses, and offline trip caching.
allProjects.description: Tour Partner was inspired by frequent journeys exploring the scenic landscapes of Bangladesh. The application solves common travel pain points: organizing multi-day itineraries, locating hidden viewpoints using Google Maps, calculating and splitting shared costs among group members, and caching all itinerary details locally so travelers never get stranded without data in mountainous regions.
allProjects.objective: Create a fast, 60fps native mobile app unifying trip discovery, GPS waypoint planning, and transparent expense bookkeeping into an offline-first Flutter application.
features: Destination discovery feed with high-resolution photography and travel tips
Interactive multi-stop itinerary planner integrated with Google Maps API
Shared travel expense ledger with automatic split calculation and currency conversion
Traveler profile with completed trip history, badges, and passport logs
Offline-first SQLite caching for zero-connectivity journeys
Fluid Material 3 design system with customizable light and dark themes

images.caption: Explore Feed showing featured travel destinations and trip discovery recommendations
Traveler Profile showcasing trip statistics, saved itineraries, and travel history
Preferences and theme customization panel with dark/light appearance toggles
System Architecture, developer credits, and versioning info screen

allProjects.title: Health Assistant
allProjects.subtitle: Digital Healthcare & Wellness Suite
allProjects.overview: A fast medical utility mobile app providing quick access to emergency doctors, verified blood banks, BMI/IBW diagnostics, and healthy nutrition guides.
allProjects.description: Health Assistant bridges patients with urgent medical utilities through a streamlined Material 3 mobile application. Users can search verified doctors across medical specialties, dial emergency clinics directly, identify compatible blood donors across regional registries, and calculate personal health metrics with instant clinical feedback.
allProjects.objective: Provide a rapid, life-saving mobile directory and clinical calculator suite that operates smoothly under emergency conditions.
features: Medical utility dashboard with one-tap emergency calling
Specialty doctor directory with clinic hours and consultation booking
Verified blood bank registry with blood group compatibility lookup
Integrated BMI and Ideal Body Weight diagnostic calculators
Dietary guidance and preventive health nutrition tips

images.caption: Clinical Dashboard with quick access to doctors, blood donors, and diagnostics
Doctor Directory categorized by clinical specialties with consultation booking

allProjects.title: IBW Calculator
allProjects.subtitle: Ideal Body Weight Medical Diagnostics
allProjects.overview: Medical ideal weight diagnostics app with support for Imperial & Metric units, custom body frame calculations, and instant clinical dietary advice.
allProjects.description: Engineered for clinicians and fitness enthusiasts, the IBW Calculator applies clinically validated formulas (Devine and Robinson) to determine exact healthy weight targets. The app accounts for biological gender, height measurements, and bone frame classifications, presenting results alongside supportive lifestyle advice.
allProjects.objective: Deliver precise, evidence-based weight targets with an intuitive dual-unit interface.
features: Imperial (ft/in, lbs) and Metric (cm, kg) unit conversion
Devine and Robinson clinical formula algorithms
Body frame classification adjustments (small, medium, large)
Personalized nutritional recommendation cards

images.caption: Diagnostic input form with unit switches and frame size selector
Calculated Ideal Weight result range with clinical dietary recommendations

allProjects.title: Sign Up / Login UI Kit
allProjects.subtitle: Cyan Flow Mobile Authentication System
allProjects.overview: Production-grade mobile authentication system with responsive form validation, biometric login hooks, and session recovery in a high-contrast modern design.
allProjects.description: A comprehensive UI kit for cross-platform authentication flows. Designed in Flutter with responsive constraints, real-time input validators, password security strength meters, biometric authentication prompts, and social OAuth providers.
allProjects.objective: Provide a reusable, secure, visually captivating authentication foundation for mobile applications.
features: High-contrast cyan flow visual design language
Asynchronous email availability and password complexity validation
Biometric fingerprint and Face ID simulation hooks
Clean separation between auth state and presentation layer

images.caption: Create Account registration screen with field validators and social OAuth buttons
Welcome Back login screen with biometric authentication hook

allProjects.title: BMI Calculator
allProjects.subtitle: Interactive Body Mass Index Monitor
allProjects.overview: Body mass index monitoring with fluid real-time slider inputs, immediate classification calculations, and supportive health recommendations.
allProjects.description: An engaging wellness tool that computes Body Mass Index dynamically as users glide fluid sliders. Results are plotted instantly against World Health Organization criteria with visual color meters and supportive exercise tips.
allProjects.objective: Transform clinical health calculation into a satisfying, tactile interactive user experience.
features: Fluid real-time height and weight slider controls
Instant WHO health category calculation (Underweight, Normal, Overweight, Obese)
Visual radial scale gauge indicating health zone
Personalized health and hydration advice

images.caption: Interactive Slider Screen for real-time height and weight adjustments
WHO Health Category Analysis result card with supportive lifestyle tips
